noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.410 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.448, Score minimum: 0.277

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. fliprate (score: 0.448)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.23 vs bruit blanc 0.24
     - Hurst max: 1.090, Pente FFT: -0.242
  2. flip (score: 0.448)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.23 vs bruit blanc 0.24
     - Hurst max: 1.090, Pente FFT: -0.242
  3. energy (score: 0.442)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.23 vs bruit blanc 0.24
     - Hurst max: 1.149, Pente FFT: -0.168

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. localvar (score: 0.435)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.104
  2. magnetization (score: 0.411)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.011
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.277)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.947
